posts.topic_title: Doctor laser - one of the last holographers
posts.author: kyodai
posts.post_subject: Doctor laser - one of the last holographers
posts.content_md:
Its actually his SUBTERRANEAN lab. Lol. I think he's really a good guy. Whether you like 360 degree film holograms or not - it's still amazing how many people he got holographed that way. Probably most busy portrait holographer ever.

Maybe it means something, maybe not. But still i think it's cool that you can go to his small gallery in NY and take a peek at Andy warhol reading a newspaper or Isaac Asimov sitting on a chair. I am sure noone here is "Mashed potatoes", but Kudos to him for keeping up that little holo studio in NY and turning it into a legend. I think he's there since like 40 years or so. I'm not sure he's like "the greatest holographer", but maybe at least the "loudest". I'm glad he's still alive and keeping holography kinda "visible" in the heart of NY. I wish every larger city had a guy like him.
